question: How many bahurūpa-kalās are to be arranged in the vidyā-body?
premises: The bahurūpa-kalās are the subject of arrangement.
They are to be arranged in the vidyā-body.
inference: One should arrange the eight bahurūpa-kalās in the vidyā-body.
plain_english: One should arrange the eight bahurūpa-kalās in the vidyā-body.
